title: Ageing is Living Leadership Course 2027: Unlocking the potential of population ageing
about: WHO/Europe's in-person leadership course on population ageing runs 28-30 April 2027 in Bilbao, Bizkaia, for 40 participants. It is APHEA-accredited with a WHO certificate of participation. Applications opened 1 October 2026 and close 16 November 2026.
requirements: Applicants describe a current leadership, policy or systems challenge within their area of responsibility that affects how people live and age
Priority to applicants in a position to translate learning into policy, organizational or systems-level action
card_alt: Card for the Ageing is Living Leadership Course 2027: Unlocking the potential of population ageing, by the WHO Regional Office for Europe, held onsite in Bilbao, Spain, with an application deadline of 16 Nov 2026. The photo shows the Sagrada Família basilica in Barcelona at sunset, representing Spain.
